audit.why: That is the stage the win rate comes from: ghouls and the Maiden grind turrets down faster than he re-lays them, and Heimerdinger has no dash to leave a Dark Procession cage. His first-item CDR window is real; the two-item one is yours.
audit.corrected: spikes[3] and late rewritten to hand the two-item side lane back to you, matching the corrected chart.

audit.corrected: Micro-Rockets named with its range and cooldown, UPGRADE!!! named with its cooldown and effect, and the grenade given its full name and flat 11s cooldown.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 8.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track CH-2 Grenade and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track his grenade and how disciplined your pattern is.

edits.before: Hard matchup — difficulty 8.5/10, Heimerdinger carry threat 8.5/10.
edits.after: Favoured matchup — difficulty 5/10, Heimerdinger carry threat 8.5/10.

edits.before: His self-peel stun. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade stuns on a direct hit, 11s flat. Commit after.

edits.before: Trade strictly around CH-2 Grenade: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If behind, farm safe and let your spikes re-open the lane.
edits.after: Trade around the grenade's flat 11s: when it is spent, run the full pattern. UPGRADE!!! is 100s at rank 1 and empowers his next spell, so the upgraded grenade is the long stun.

edits.before: Heimerdinger's turrets and beam out-range you at level 1 and zone you off the wave.
edits.after: Level 1 is even — one turret out and no Micro-Rockets yet, so just farm the wave.

edits.before: In the 2+ item stage a fed Heimer fortresses the side lane, favouring him.
edits.after: In the 2+ item stage Maiden and ghouls out-siege a Heimer who cannot duel.

edits.before: Heimerdinger owns the early lane — his turrets (Q) and beam poke zone you off farm and out-range everything you have before ghouls stack, so give ground, soak shots with ghouls, and just survive to 6.
edits.after: Level 1 is even with a single H-28 G turret down, but from 2 he owns the lane — turret beams plus 1325-range Hextech Micro-Rockets out-range everything you have, so give ground, soak shots with ghouls, and survive to 6.

edits.before: Level 3 offers a brief skill window, but he's back ahead at 4-5 with a full turret nest; your real spike is level 6, where Maiden plus ghouls dive and delete his turrets faster than he can rebuild, and no dash saves him from your wall.
edits.after: Level 3 offers a brief skill window, but he's back ahead at 4-5 with a full nest plus Micro-Rockets every 11s. Your real spike is level 6, where Maiden and ghouls delete turrets faster than he rebuilds them, and with no dash in his kit the cage is a wall he simply cannot pass.

edits.before: Once Heimer hits his first item his CDR gives permanent triple-turret uptime and his Grenade (E) stun peels your dive, so the side lane becomes a fortress — stop trying to solo-shove it and instead group, using ghouls and Maiden to dive him in fights where turrets aren't pre-placed.
edits.after: Once Heimer hits his first item his CDR gives permanent triple-turret uptime and the 11s grenade stun peels your dive. By two items it flips back: ghouls and Maiden grind turrets down faster than he re-lays them, and he still has no dash out of Dark Procession, so take the side lane he cannot personally hold.

edits.before: A fed Heimer turns the side lane into a fortress you can't shove through; don't try to out-split him — group and let ghouls dive the backline where his turrets can't be pre-placed.
edits.after: By two items you out-siege him: ghouls and Maiden grind his turrets down faster than he re-lays them, and Heimerdinger himself cannot duel you or leave a cage without a dash.

edits.after: Stun your all-in with CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade
